about: Realistic clean program: every finding on it is false. Scored for rules only. Instructions by tag (first data byte), accounts in index order. load_registry / load_vesting check owner == program id, exact length, type tag and the address re-derived from the stored bump (create_program_address); every lamport debit is from a program-owned vesting PDA.

why.admin: Signer and key == ADMIN (hard-coded): only the deployer's admin creates the registry.
why.registry: Key == find_program_address([registry]); created by system create_account signed with the PDA seeds (fails if it exists).
load_registry (owner, length, tag, PDA) and writable; fee_bps <= 500.

why.new_admin: Signer and key == registry.pending_admin (reset to the default key afterwards, which nobody can sign for).

why.funder: Signer; pays rent + total from its own lamports (create_account from the funder). Permissionless by design: anyone locks its own SOL for any beneficiary.
why.beneficiary: Any key, the funder's choice (only stored).
why.vesting: Key == find_program_address([vesting, funder, seed]); created by create_account signed with those seeds.
load_vesting (owner, length, tag, PDA [vesting, funder, seed] with the stored bump), writable. Only vested - released moves (u128 linear vesting, checked).
why.beneficiary: Key == vesting.beneficiary: the payout can only go to the stored beneficiary, so the crank is permissionless by design.

why.funder: Signer and key == vesting.funder; the schedule must be revocable and not yet revoked. Only the unvested part returns to the funder; the vested part stays for the beneficiary (total := vested).
why.clock: Key == the Clock sysvar id (and Clock::from_account_info checks it again).

why.vesting: load_vesting, writable. The PDA seeds do not include the beneficiary, so the address check still holds after the change.
why.new_beneficiary: Any key, the current beneficiary's choice.

why.beneficiary: Signer and key == vesting.beneficiary; only once released == total.
why.vesting: load_vesting, writable; data zeroed, all lamports moved out.
why.funder: Key == vesting.funder: the rent returns to whoever paid it.

why.remaining pairs (vesting, beneficiary): each pair through release_one: vesting load_vesting + writable, beneficiary key == vesting.beneficiary. The same vesting twice releases 0 the second time (released stored before the lamports move). Permissionless like release.
